character.name: Branoc Ironfell
character.background: Disgraced Noble, Falsely Accused of Treason
traits: Stoic Silence: Rarely speaks unless necessary, and never reveals more than he intends. His quiet nature unsettles others, but he never wastes words on falsehoods.
Unyielding Honesty: Cannot tell a lie, even when it would save his own life. This rigid honesty has cost him dearly more than once.
Guilt-Ridden: Blames himself entirely for the breaking of his divine oath, despite knowing he was framed. He carries the weight of his perceived failure every waking moment.
Vengeful Resolve: Is utterly single-minded in his quest to clear his name or kill the traitor who destroyed his life. No distraction, comfort, or risk will stand in his way.
character.gear: Dented steel shield · Crushed chain mail · Family heirloom longsword · 3 dried venison rations · Tarnished Silver Order holy symbol · 2 throwing daggers · 50ft hempen rope · Flint and steel
character.story: Branoc Ironfell, once a knight of the Silver Order, was framed for regicide by his own mentor. Stripped of his title and divine oath, he wanders the borderlands as a disgraced oathbreaker. He carries his dented armor as a reminder of his failure, his stoic silence hiding a burning need to clear his name—or spill the traitor's blood. He knows the truth: his oath broke not from weakness, but because his mentor poisoned his sacred vows.

inventory.name: Family Heirloom Longsword
inventory.lore: Forged by the Ironfell family's ancestral smith, this blade was gifted to Branoc when he earned his knighthood. The edge is nicked from a hundred battles, and the pommel bears the cracked crest of the Silver Order, half-scratched away in shame.
inventory.description: A well-worn longsword with a dented pommel, the Ironfell crest barely visible beneath deep scratches.

inventory.name: Dented Steel Shield
inventory.lore: Passed down from Branoc's father, this shield took a brutal mace blow during the ambush that framed Branoc for treason. The dent near the rim still holds a splinter of the mace's head.
inventory.description: A battered steel shield with a deep dent and the cracked Ironfell crest painted on its face.

inventory.name: Crushed Chain Mail
inventory.lore: Branoc's ceremonial chain mail, dented and stained with mud from the night he fled the capital. The links are still slightly warped from the blow that knocked him unconscious during his arrest.
inventory.description: A suit of interlocked steel rings, dented in several places and missing a few links near the left shoulder.

inventory.name: Tarnished Silver Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: Once a beacon of Branoc's divine power, this holy symbol of the Silver Order is now tarnished and dull. It only glows faintly when Branoc is near those who betrayed him, a remnant of his broken oath.
inventory.description: A small silver disc etched with the winged crest of the Silver Order, tarnished almost black except for a single unscratched wing.
inventory.effects: Once per day, emits a faint burst of radiant light that reveals invisible creatures within 10 feet for 1 round.

inventory.name: Dried Venison Rations
inventory.lore: These rations were packed by Branoc's sister before he left the capital, the last gift she gave him before she was taken hostage by the traitors.
inventory.description: Tough, dried strips of venison, still slightly sweet from the honey used to preserve them.

inventory.name: Throwing Daggers
inventory.lore: These daggers were taken from the men who ambushed Branoc the night he fled. The blades are still stained with the blood of the traitors' mercenaries.
inventory.description: Two small steel daggers, balanced for throwing, with black leather grips.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope (50ft)
inventory.lore: This rope was used by Branoc to rappel down the palace wall the night he escaped. It's frayed near one end from the descent.
inventory.description: A 50-foot coil of thick hempen rope, frayed at one end.

inventory.name: Flint and Steel
inventory.lore: A standard flint and steel set, given to Branoc by a borderland blacksmith who recognized his disgraced sigil and offered him shelter.
inventory.description: A piece of flint and a steel striker, wrapped in oiled cloth to keep dry.

inventory.name: Tarnished Silver Order holy symbol
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
